title: Pervasiveness of Adapt and Grow Initiative in Healthcare Sector
what_it_is: Pervasiveness of Adapt and Grow Initiative in Healthcare Sector

sections.label: Healthcare mid-career recruitment programmes
sections.summary: MOH will enhance the Professional Conversion Programme for mid-career nurses and offer overseas nursing Masters scholarships from 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Some 300 jobseekers were placed into the healthcare sector through this initiative last year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Complementing this, the Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) has also been organising recruitment fairs, through which about 400 mid-career locals were hired in 2016.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: MOH will enhance the Professional Conversion Programme (PCP) to recruit more mid-career Singaporeans as nurses.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We will increase funding support for employers of mid-career nurses for their professional conversion training and on-the-job training.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: In addition, we will offer overseas nursing Masters scholarships starting from 2017 for non-nursing degree graduates to pursue nursing studies.

sections.label: Support care staff place-and-train
sections.summary: MOH will enhance place-and-train programmes for mid-career support care staff and provide on-the-job training funding to employers.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: MOH will also enhance its place-and-train programmes to recruit mid-career individuals into support care staff positions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: On-the-job training funding support will be provided to public healthcare and community care employers for every newly hired support care workers.
